Links use reference-style formatting

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<p><a href='https://example.com'>Example</a> and <a href='https://other.com'>Other</a></p>", "{\"link_style\":\"Reference\"}");
```
